title: /string
description: The mod adds /string command which fills your empty slots with string!
body:
# /string v2.1.1

/string is a fabric mod that helps the players with villager trades and lack of string ingeneral!

## Features

* Adds the `/string` command.
* Fills only empty inventory slots.
* Configurable command cooldown.
* OP-only `/stringconfig`.
  * `fullinv` — fills all empty inventory slots with stacks of 64 string.
  * `custom` — gives an exact amount of string set by server operator
* Compatible with LuckPerms.

## Commands

### Player Commands

* `/string`

### Operator Commands

* `/stringconfig help`
* `/stringconfig cooldown <seconds>`
* `/stringconfig amount fullinv`
* `/stringconfig amount custom <amount>`

## Requirements

* Fabric Permissions API
